business_summary: Metals Royalty Co Inc. (Nasdaq: TMCR) holds a 2.00% gross overriding royalty (the NORI Royalty) on TMC subsidiary Nauru Ocean Resources, Inc.'s CCZ nodule production, a direct revenue claim layered on top of TMC's own equity exposure to the ccz-nodule-resource link (CROWDED), subject to TMC repurchase options on up to 75% of the royalty. Metals Royalty is a pre-production royalty vehicle: vendor-statements data shows zero revenue in every reported fiscal year (2023-2025), since NORI has not yet produced.
